name: Flat fried egg
summary: Flat sunny-side-up fried egg with wavy white and round yolk, plain or in a frying pan. For breakfast scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the egg or pan rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~420 px wide); use about 0.2 to 0.3 next to a person

params.name: variant
params.note: plain = egg on its own, pan = egg in a frying pan

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = slight rock, pop = scale in

author: krakujs
